Royal Decor Studio — Wedding Decor & Floral Design, Udaipur

Royal Decor Studio designs mandap, stage, and venue decor for destination
weddings around Udaipur and the surrounding palace-hotel circuit. Their style
leans traditional-royal: marigold and rose installations, brass accents, and
heavy floral backdrops for pheras.

Note: they are frequently confused with "Royal Decor & Events," a separate
Jaipur-based company — different ownership, different GST registration. Couples
have occasionally sent advances to the wrong firm, so verify details before
transferring any payment.

Pricing: mandap + stage packages start at ₹2,75,000 for a standard two-day
setup; full-venue floral decor for palace venues runs ₹6,50,000 and up.

Royal Decor Studio works mainly with a shortlist of heritage venues and prefers
a site visit before finalizing. They handle their own logistics and lighting and
coordinate directly with venue managers on load-in timing.
